description: Track a bill such as a streaming service or membership, with an optional fee and cron renewal schedule (no more often than daily). A bill with no renewal schedule is a one-off. Set paymentDate only when the money leaves the account on a different day from the renewal.

currencyCode.description: Uppercase ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD, GBP, JPY.

value.description: Amount in the currency's minor units. Most currencies have 2 decimal places (1599 = 15.99 USD), but some have none (1500 = 1500 JPY) and a few have 3 (12345 = 12.345 KWD).

paymentDate.description: Date the first payment leaves the account, YYYY-MM-DD, when it differs from the renewal date. Payments repeat on the renewal cadence from this date. Omit when payment happens on renewal.

remindMe.description: Whether to remind the household before each renewal.

renewalCronExpression.description: Cron expression for the renewal cadence. No more often than daily. Omit for a one-off bill.

startDate.description: Renewal date, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional. For a recurring bill it is the first renewal; for a one-off it is the date it is due.

name: create_subscription
